notes: Kratos's kits (v9.7). Both weapons change the look: the Leviathan Axe in his right hand, then the Blades of Chaos (one in each hand); the round shield stays on his left forearm in both, like in the guard pictures w0guard / w1guard. Their states are generated too. The frost burst of Hel's Touch is drawn by the game; the axe throw, the chaos whirl and both ultimates keep their clips.
